caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a fitted lid, primarily colored in shades of blue, brown, white, and green. The side of the container displays a rural scene featuring a white windmill with the words "WINDMILL" and "RAIL ROAD" inscribed in gold. Flanking the windmill are trees with dark green foliage and brown trunks, and two white buildings with dark brown roofs and windows above a rolling landscape. Below these structures are two wagons filled with cargo, each with riders and pulled by a brown horse. The wheels of the wagons are outlined in gold. The top edge of the container’s lid has a decorative border with alternating green and brown elements. The lid itself shows a rural scene with brown and green trees, blue sky, and a silhouette of a person riding a horse, as well as a shadowed forested area. The background of the entire drawing is a solid beige, and the artist's name "Stewart Wheeler" is written near the bottom right.
title: Bandbox
